assessment.nobel_worthiness: Inducing degradation of a chosen protein by recruiting an E3 ligase is a genuinely new pharmacological principle: it removes the target rather than blocking it, reaches proteins once thought undruggable, and now has molecules in clinical trials. The concept is simple and the consequences are already real, which is my standard for a game-changer.
assessment.attribution: The PROTAC concept and first proof of principle trace to Crews and Deshaies (with Sakamoto and Kim as the early co-workers). Ciulli made structure-guided VHL ligands and the ternary-complex mechanism that made the approach rational. Handa/Ito (thalidomide-cereblon) and Gray are important for molecular glues, so the credit is crowded and a three-person cut leaves out real contributors.
assessment.maturity: Over twenty years since the first PROTAC and independently confirmed by many groups. Clinical readouts are accumulating but no degrader is yet a broadly approved drug. Timing is good but arguably still slightly early.
uncertainties: Whether the prize should centre on PROTACs or on molecular glues/cereblon biology (Handa, Ito), which would change the laureate set
Clinical validation is still maturing; I cannot independently verify the latest trial status
Early credit for Sakamoto and Kim cannot be recognised under the three-person limit

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Massively parallel sequencing-by-synthesis with reversible terminators transformed biology and medicine and made the genome a routine measurement. It is a chemical invention at heart (nucleotide chemistry, surface chemistry, fluorescence detection) with enormous demonstrated consequences.
assessment.attribution: Balasubramanian and Klenerman conceived and developed the Solexa chemistry that became Illumina sequencing. Others on the list (Ju, Mayer, Rothberg) made important parallel contributions in alternative chemistries, so priority among competing technologies is a real question, but two clear central names are defensible.
assessment.maturity: Technology is mature, widely used for more than fifteen years, and its impact is beyond dispute. Recognition is, if anything, overdue.
uncertainties: Allocation versus Rothberg (454 pyrosequencing) and Mayer, and the commercial history
Whether the committee sees this as chemistry or as physiology/medicine territory
Patent and corporate narratives may blur who was decisive

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Site-specific incorporation of unnatural amino acids through orthogonal tRNA/synthetase pairs lets chemists write new chemistry into proteins in living cells. It is a clean, original idea with wide use in protein engineering, imaging and therapeutics.
assessment.attribution: Schultz and co-workers (Wang being the key early student/postdoc) established the in vivo approach; Chin extended it to multiple amino acids, orthogonal ribosomes and quadruplet codons. Yokoyama and Mehl contributed important systems, so the cut is not unique but a Schultz, Chin, Wang trio is coherent.
assessment.maturity: Twenty-plus years of independent adoption. The field is mature, though the most ambitious genome-recoding applications are still developing.
uncertainties: Weighting of Schultz versus Chin as the decisive originator
Overlap with the in vitro code reprogramming work of Suga (B004), which may be a competing framing
Credit for early coworkers is limited by the three-laureate cap

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Ab initio molecular dynamics put electronic structure and atomic motion into one simulation, opening quantitative study of liquids, interfaces, and reactions from first principles. It is fundamental and has been used in thousands of studies.
assessment.attribution: Car and Parrinello are the unambiguous originators of the 1985 method. Two names suffice and no conflict is apparent. Parrinello also appears under metadynamics and machine-learned potentials, which could make a combined recognition natural.
assessment.maturity: Four decades of validation and routine use. Its accuracy is limited by the underlying density functional, but that does not weaken the originality of the method. Recognition is overdue as a theory/simulation prize.
uncertainties: Chemistry has recently recognised computational work (2013, 2024), so the committee may feel the area is covered
Whether a Parrinello prize should instead be framed around enhanced sampling or ML potentials
I am close to this field and may be biased toward simulation work

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Nitrogenase is the central enzyme of biological nitrogen fixation and its iron-molybdenum cofactor with an interstitial carbide is one of the most striking active sites known. Structure plus mechanism connects directly to my interest in how metalloenzymes catalyse hard reactions.
assessment.attribution: Rees (first crystal structures and the cofactor), Einsle (the central light atom and high-resolution structures) and Seefeldt (kinetics and mechanism) make a plausible trio. Dean and Ribbe also have strong claims, and the genetics (Dean) versus structure divide is a real attribution problem.
assessment.maturity: The structure is well established, but the catalytic mechanism, especially substrate binding and the E4 state, is still being worked out. A prize for structure would be mature; for mechanism it would be premature.
uncertainties: Mechanism of N2 reduction is not fully settled
Allocation among Rees, Einsle, Dean, Ribbe and Seefeldt is genuinely contested
I cannot verify the very latest cryo-EM mechanistic findings

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Showing that a mutant cysteine in KRAS G12C can be targeted covalently turned a famously undruggable oncoprotein into a drug target and led directly to approved drugs. The idea is simple, new, and has clear patient consequences.
assessment.attribution: Shokat is the clear driver of the KRAS G12C tethering work and also of the chemical genetics of kinases (analogue-sensitive alleles). Industry teams developed the approved drugs, so the prize would be for the concept; a single laureate is supportable but could be paired with others.
assessment.maturity: Concept confirmed by approved drugs (sotorasib, adagrasib), though resistance and long-term benefit are still being studied. Timely.
uncertainties: Whether the committee would prefer to pair Shokat with a medicinal-chemistry or covalent-drug co-laureate
Credit split between academic proof of concept and industrial drug development
Entry bundles two themes (KRAS and kinase chemical genetics), which may need separate recognition

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Base editing converts one base to another without double-strand breaks by pairing a deaminase with a programmable DNA-binding protein. It is a clean chemical idea with immediate therapeutic relevance, including clinical use in patients.
assessment.attribution: Liu is clearly the intellectual leader. Komor and Gaudelli were the decisive trainees and Kondo and Nishida produced an independent related approach. A single laureate is the most defensible allocation, though Liu may also be linked with prime editing.
assessment.maturity: Roughly ten years old, with early clinical results. Confirmation is broad, but long-term safety and efficacy are still emerging, so recognition may be somewhat early.
uncertainties: Possible competition with CRISPR-related prizes already awarded in 2020
Liu's contributions are spread over base editing, prime editing (B015) and DNA-templated chemistry (B031), which complicates framing
Long-term clinical data are limited

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Selective C-H functionalization changes how molecules are made by turning ubiquitous C-H bonds into reactive sites, with ligand and template control for site selectivity. It is widely used in synthesis and in pharmaceutical routes.
assessment.attribution: Yu (ligand-accelerated and template-directed activation), Hartwig (borylation, amination) and Sanford (Pd/Ni catalysis) are leading figures. Daugulis and Smith (borylation) have clear priority in places, and Bergman (B041) holds the foundational alkane activation, so priority is disputed.
assessment.maturity: Well established and independently reproduced, but the field is diffuse and the most important advance may lie in industrial use rather than a single discovery.
uncertainties: No single unifying discovery, so prize framing is hard
Priority overlap with Bergman (B041) and Hartwig's C-N coupling (B055)
Competes with already honoured cross-coupling (2010) as a synthetic-methods prize
